limitations: Token capture for antigravity is intentionally OUT OF SCOPE (deferred): agy's CLI surface (stdout + --log-file) does not expose per-call token usage, and its trajectory store holds only undocumented protobuf config + raw transcript — extracting usage would require inference or reading raw content, both forbidden by the usage-ledger invariants. So antigravity calls are source=unavailable (honest) until agy exposes usage on a stable surface. Production Authority 3x2 strong-proof was unavailable (live runner unprovisioned); review assurance used the sanctioned degraded single-host 3x1 fallback.
